podcast.body: The Beatles' song, a "morose meditation on all the lonely people" primarily penned by Paul McCartney, reached number 11 on the charts in 1966. Aretha Franklin's transformative 1969 cover nearly matched its pop peak while achieving a higher R&B chart position. "The Beatles took Eleanor Rigby to number 11 in 66."
